description: Look up sourced 2026 creator-income data. topic=programs lists monetization programs with eligibility (subscribers, watch hours, views) and status; rpm_by_niche and rpm_by_country give earnings per 1,000 views as low, high and median; engagement_benchmarks gives typical engagement rates; sponsorship_rates gives price ranges per post. Every row carries its sources. Use it to answer 'how much does X pay' or 'what do I need to monetize'; for a concrete earnings estimate from a view count use estimate_youtube_earnings instead. Offline data, max 40 rows.

country.description: Optional country filter for rpm_by_country: ISO code (US, DE, IN) or English name.

niche.description: Optional niche filter for rpm_by_niche and sponsorship_rates, substring: finance, tech, gaming, beauty, education ...

platform.description: Optional platform filter, substring: YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X, Snapchat ...

name: creator_monetization
title: Creator monetization data
